identity.title: Isolate corrupt transactions during handoff discovery

origin.summary: The remaining 2D reconciliation identifies a focused integration gap where one malformed transaction can abort discovery of later valid transactions.

state.current_summary: 2D-040 remains resolved as a bounded discovery-isolation slice: valid transactions remain discoverable when one handoff envelope is malformed, a typed MalformedMessage diagnostic is preserved, and the damaged transaction is neither acknowledged, executed, nor deleted. The final Debug and Release smoke binaries passed after the missing-handoff/permission-path refinement; permission-denied, concurrent-writer, crash/reconnect, throughput, offline-PC, hardware, and broad UI qualification remain separate boundaries.

objective.summary: Keep valid transaction discovery available when one transaction envelope cannot be read or parsed, and preserve a typed diagnostic without acknowledging, deleting, or executing the damaged transaction.
constraints: Reuse TwoDIntegrationExchange and TwoDIntegrationTcpExchange; do not add a parallel exchange or generic registry.
Keep DiscoverHandoffs compatibility for existing callers while exposing the item diagnostics through an additive detailed result.
Catch only item-level discovery failures; do not hide catastrophic process failures or root enumeration failures.
Use isolated fixture data and place all runtime evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not modify, stage, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not claim crash recovery, reconnect, offline-PC, hardware, or throughput qualification from this fixture.

criteria.text: With two valid transaction envelopes and one malformed envelope, detailed discovery returns both valid transactions and exactly one typed diagnostic for the malformed transaction.
The existing DiscoverHandoffs API still returns the two valid transactions, and the damaged transaction produces no Acknowledgement, Result, or automatic deletion.

The issue record, reconciliation report, current handoff, and Documentation Map identify the existing owner/call path, focused fixture, D-drive evidence, self-evaluation, and remaining integration boundaries so 2D-040 is not repeated.

context.summary: The existing exchange owner enumerates transaction directories and reads handoff envelopes; the detailed result isolates item failures while preserving the legacy valid-summary projection.
The discovery slice reads only; it does not mutate, acknowledge, execute, or delete a transaction.

context.location: TwoDIntegrationExchange.DiscoverHandoffsDetailed -> ReadHandoffEnvelope -> IntegrationContractJson.DeserializeHandoffV2; then TwoDIntegrationTcpExchange wrapper -> TwoDIntegrationSmoke discovery-isolation route
context.summary: This is the shortest source/test path for the changed behavior.

evidence.observation: The existing discovery owner now projects valid summaries through an additive DiscoverHandoffsDetailed result. Each valid-GUID transaction is read independently; item-level contract, JSON, file, and access failures become a TwoDIntegrationDiscoveryDiagnostic, while the legacy DiscoverHandoffs method continues returning only valid summaries. No ACK, Result, or delete path is called during discovery.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug x64 build completed with 0 errors. The build reported 19 existing nullable warnings in unrelated smoke contracts and produced the runner used by the focused fixture.

The isolated fixture passed with validTransactionCount=2, legacyTransactionCount=2, diagnosticCount=1, diagnosticErrorCode=MalformedMessage, and no acknowledgement or result published for the corrupt transaction. The runner exited 0.

The reconciliation report records PL-0100 as the single 2D-040 owner with its source call path, fixture, D-drive evidence, self-evaluation, and unverified boundaries; the live Handoff and Documentation Map retain the duplicate-prevention rule and link the current coordination record.

The Release x64 smoke binary repeated the discovery-isolation contract with validTransactionCount=2, legacyTransactionCount=2, diagnosticCount=1, diagnosticErrorCode=MalformedMessage, and no acknowledgement or result published for the corrupt transaction. The Release build completed with 0 errors and the runner exited 0.

After the final source refinement, both Debug and Release builds completed with 0 errors, and both discovery-isolation runs exited 0 with validTransactionCount=2, legacyTransactionCount=2, diagnosticCount=1, diagnosticErrorCode=MalformedMessage, and no acknowledgement or result for the corrupt transaction.

events.summary: 2D-040 is resolved after the valid-plus-malformed discovery fixture passed. The legacy API remains compatible, typed diagnostics preserve the damaged item, and no mutation occurred; broader access, concurrency, recovery, transport, hardware, and UI boundaries remain unverified.
